mentions.name: SSTV iOS app
mentions.description: An iOS app that encodes images into sound so they can be transmitted over (ham) radio, similar to Slow Scan TV broadcasts the ISS regularly sends.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a SSTV ios app - you can encode images in sound and transmit these over (ham) radio. The ISS regularly broadcasts these too.
